usageNotes: Use this endpoint to get a cross-remote inventory snapshot of all resource types (VMs, containers, nodes, storages, PBS datastores, SDN networks) registered in PDM. Results are served from a per-remote cache with a default max-age of 30 seconds, so resource states may lag real-time by up to that window; lower max-age for fresher data at the cost of more remote round-trips. The optional 'view' parameter filters results to a named PDM view, which must already exist under /config/views.

examples.summary: Fetch all resources with a tighter 10-second cache window

tips: Each object in the 'resources' array carries a 'type' discriminator field (pve-qemu, pve-lxc, pve-node, pve-storage, pve-network, pbs-node, pbs-datastore) — filter on this to process only the resource class you need.
If a remote is unreachable, PDM returns the last cached data and populates the top-level 'error' field with a description; always check for 'error' before trusting stale resource states.
Setting max-age=0 forces a live fetch from every remote on every call — use sparingly in polling loops to avoid hammering remote APIs.
The 'view' parameter must match the pattern /^(?:[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._\-]*)$/ — use get_config_views to enumerate valid view names before passing one here.
